correctness.rationale: On the total set of reproducing kernels, the products are exponential-affine weighted compositions with common slope v=a times conjugate(c). Independently, for T=e^(delta+beta z) C_(vz+w), TT* is the weighted composition with slope r=|v|², shift conjugate(gamma) and linear weight gamma=beta+v times conjugate(w), and constant e^(2 Re(delta)+|w|²). Conjugating the centered dilation D_r by the Weyl shift h=conjugate(gamma)/(1-r) multiplies that weighted composition's constant by e^(-|gamma|²/(1-r)). Thus the square roots of its eigenvalues give exactly the two claimed sequences on substitution, with a single nonzero singular value at v=0. Their scale difference is a Hermitian form with positive diagonals and determinant -|a-c|²; it is (1-|a|²)|b-d|² for a=c and is indefinite otherwise. Real rescaling in the two signs gives the entire positive ratio range. The frozen numerical checks are finite and were inspected, not rerun.
